The desired phenotype was "a zebrafish that glides at least 5 m from a 1 m launch and survives 10-30 C as an adult". It parsed into 3 hard criteria, all at the adult stage: c1, glide_range_total_m >= 5 m from a 1 m launch; c2, survives at 10 C; c3, survives at 30 C. Nothing was left unparsed or refused. The parser's assumptions were: adult assumed, no editable parameters stated (so the optimizer has nothing to vary), and Lean constraints always must-hold.

SEQUENCE BASIS. The basis is document-only. loci_covered is 0 and genome_fraction_assessed is 0. NO SEQUENCE WAS ASSESSED. The generated document carries no gene-level edit, and the differences between the two organisms are morphological parameter deltas, not alleles.

THE FIVE RESULTS, each with its own gate, not combined:
- genotype_similarity: cannot-assess. The design has no gene-level edit, so there is no edited sequence state to compare. This is not a pass. No genotype was assessed.
- phenotype_similarity: pass. The design is inside the calibrated shape distribution (body p 1). This is shape similarity to real specimens, not relatedness, and it is silent on every feature the comparison does not read.
- lean_check: cannot-assess. No Lean law could be evaluated (25 cannot-evaluate, 10 out of scope). No accepted-law violation was found, but that is not a pass.
- functional_resolution: fail. 19 differences from the closest functional analogue are unresolved, so the design is not functionally accounted for. The analogues were flying fishes (Exocoetidae) and zebrafish (Danio rerio).
- physics_check: fail. The glide criterion was not met. The reachable launch speed of 0.67 m/s is below v_min of 8.64 m/s. Glide was achieved in 0.0% of 200 draws, with a median of 0 m. VERDICT. The word "validated" is withheld (word_validated_withheld true). The reasons are: 2 gate(s) failed; 2 gate(s) could not be assessed; 3 biological scale(s) could not be assessed; no sequence was compared at any locus. This report says what was checked and what was not. It is not a validity claim.

SCALES NOT ASSESSED. Cell and tissue had 0 terms reached. Organ_system had 1 term reached, but it has no molecular record and no swept gene. Organ and body were assessable. The omics layers (sequence_genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, ptm, pathway) each swept 9 genes and are marked assessable. That is gene-sweep coverage, not a sequence comparison.
